_readme: luxcapital.com Webflow company pages, enumerated from sitemap.xml and parsed by scratch/site-pull.py
_attribution_note: Per-deal partner attribution (company_partner-slugs) is published only inside the 'Similar companies' cards, never on the company's own page, and the /companies listing renders a curated 28 of the 215 rows with no pagination to load the rest (Finsweet load-under with no next link; confirmed in the browser pane, 8 scroll passes, count stayed 28). The union of every related card across all 215 pages covers 40 companies, which is what this file carries; the remaining rows have no published attribution and their Form D clusters are resolved by roster tenure windows instead.
